candidate.user_submission: Child is 59 months old. Caregiver says there is cough or difficult breathing. No diarrhoea reported. Ear problem not present. Fever not present. I counted breaths for a full minute. Chest indrawing was not seen. The child was calm during assessment. Cough has been there for 3 days. Pulse oximeter not available. No recurrent wheeze history. Respiratory rate counted at 40 breaths per minute. No stridor when calm. No wheezing heard. Child is not convulsing now. No history of convulsions. Child is alert, not lethargic or unconscious. Able to drink or breastfeed. Not vomiting everything.
